acceptGovernance().notice: setGovernance() should be called by the existing governance address prior to calling this function.

addCubeToken(string,bool,uint256,uint256.notice: Add a new cube token. Can only be called by governance.

collectProtocolFees().notice: Collect protocol fees accrued so far.

deposit(address,address).notice: Deposit ETH to mint cube tokens

emergencyWithdraw().notice: Transfer all ETH to governance in case of emergency. Cannot be called if already finalized

poolBalance().notice: Balance of ETH in this contract that belongs to cube token holders. The remaining ETH are the accrued protocol fees that can be collected by governance.

quote(address).notice: Calculate price of a cube token in ETH multiplied by 1e18, excluding fees. This price applies to both depositing and withdrawing.

quoteDeposit(address,uint256).notice: Calculate amount of cube tokens received by depositing `ethIn` ETH.

quoteWithdraw(address,uint256).notice: Calculate ETH withdrawn when burning `cubeTokensIn` cube tokens.

setAllPaused(bool,bool,bool).notice: Pause or unpause for all cube tokens

setDepositWithdrawFee(address,uint256).notice: Set fee in basis points charged on each deposit and withdrawal. For example a value of 150 means a 1.5% fee. Some of this fee goes to the protocol while the rest goes back into the pool.

setGovernance(address).notice: Governance address is not update until the new governance address has called acceptGovernance() to accept this responsibility.

setGuardian(address).notice: Set guardian. This is a trusted account with the powers to pause and unpause trading and to emergency withdraw. These protections are needed for example to protect funds if there is an oracle mispricing.

setMaxPoolBalance(uint256).notice: Set max pool balance for a guarded launch. This is a limit for the ETH balance deposited in the pool excluding accrued protocol fees. A value of 0 means no limit.

setMaxPoolShare(address,uint256).notice: Set max pool share for a cube token. Expressed in basis points. A value of 0 means no limit. This protects users from buying cube tokens with limited upside, as well as protecting the whole pool from the volatility of a single asset.

setPaused(address,bool,bool,bool).notice: Pause or unpause deposits withdrawals and price updates

setProtocolFee(uint256).notice: Set protocol fee in basis points. This is the cut of fees that go to the protocol. For example a value of 2000 means 20% of fees go to the protocol and 80% go back into the pool.

update(address).notice: Update the stored cube token price and total equity. This is automatically called whenever there's a deposit or withdrawal for this cube token. However if this hasn't happened for a while, this method should be called by an external keeper so that the total equity doesn't get too far out of sync.

updateAll(uint256).notice: Update all cube tokens which haven't been updated in the last `maxStaleTime` seconds. Should be called periodically by an external keeper so that the total equity doesn't get too far out of sync.

withdraw(address,uint256,address).notice: Burn cube tokens to withdraw ETH

userdoc.notice: Parimutuel pool where users can deposit ETH to mint cube tokens          and burn them to withdraw ETH. Cube tokens represents a share of          the pool and the pool share is adjusted continuously as the price          of the underlying asset changes. Cube tokens such as cubeBTC          approximately track BTC price ^ 3, while inverse cube tokens such          as invBTC approximately track 1 / BTC price ^ 3.
